mechanics.claim: The bolt hits only the first enemy hit per cast; the recast bolt(s) apply the same effects separately to whoever they hit.
mechanics.quote: fires a plasma bolt in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit

mechanics.claim: The recast is automatic upon hitting an enemy or reaching max range, and can also be manually triggered after the 0.25s minimum flight time.
mechanics.quote: can be recast after {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the bolt is in flight, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy or reaching maximum range

mechanics.claim: An enemy cannot be hit twice by the same cast's bolts even if a spell shield blocked one.
mechanics.quote: An enemy cannot be hit by multiple bolts even when having blocked one with a {{tip|spell shield}}

mechanics.claim: The initial cast (not the manual detonation/split) counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, not on the bolt landing or splitting.
Killing an enemy with Plasma Fission restores mana to Vel'Koz; this does not affect damage dealt/taken to the dummy.
mechanics.quote: Whenever ''Plasma Fission'' kills an enemy, '''Vel'Koz''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|mana}}}}.
